title: Certificate: code/spending.py
signature: eligible_changes(streams, profile) -> list[SpendingChange] ; apply(streams, changes) -> list[Stream]

streams.description: new instances with amount reduced or ended from day 0

guarantees: stop eligible iff flexibility in {stoppable, reducible_or_stoppable} and category in willing_to_stop and category not in protect.
reduce_to eligible iff flexibility in {reducible, reducible_or_stoppable} and category in willing_to_reduce and category not in protect; new_amount = minimum_allowed_amount.
A stream yields at most one change per action; stop and reduce_to never target the same stream in one candidate.
